text: Various presentations and announcements will be made at the City Council meeting.

Various presentations, introductions and announcements were made to City Council on April 7 and 8, 2021. April 7, 2021 Mayor Tory, during the morning session of the meeting, spoke of the extraordinary circumstances that everyone has faced over the last year and stated that the pandemic is the greatest crisis that the City of Toronto has faced. Mayor Tory also spoke about how, during this crisis, the City has provided extra support to those most vulnerable and has maintained and protected City Services. Mayor Tory remarked that the City is at its best when Elected Officials and the public service work together. Mayor Tory commented that there have been things that have happened and to ensure that they do not happen again, everyone must be mindful and treat each other with respect.
